newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Pacific Fire District, Mo..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Pacific Fire District, Mo..

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE
Pacific Fire Protection District
Missouri
General Obligation Bonds, Series 1997
(Bank Qualified)
SEALED BIDS will be received until 3:00 p.m., Central Time on January 30, 1997.
Each bid must be enclosed in a sealed envelope addressed to the undersigned and marked Proposal for the Purchase of Bonds.'' Bids may be submitted by mail or delivered in
person addressed to Chief Richard Friedmann on behalf of the Board of Directors at the District's Administration
Building, 136 W. Union, Pacific, Missouri 63069 or by calling in the bid to the District's Financial Advisor as provided in the Notice of Bond Sale.

The Bonds will consist of fully registered bonds in the denomination of $5,000 or any integral multiple thereof. The Bonds will be dated February 1, 1997 and will mature serially on February 1 in each year as follows:
Year Principal Year Principal Year Principal

The Bonds will bear interest from their date at rates to be determined when the Bonds are sold. Interest will be payable on February 1, 1998 and semiannually thereafter on August 1 and February 1. The Bonds maturing on and after February 1, 2008 are subject to redemption and payment prior to maturity, at the option of the District, on and after February 1, 2007 as described in the District's Preliminary Official Statement. A municipal bond insurance policy issued by MBIA INSURANCE CORPORATION guarantees payment of the principal of and interest on the Bonds when due. The Policy will be paid for by the District. A description of the Policy and the ratings assigned to the Bonds as a result of such Policy is set forth in the Preliminary Official Statement. Boatmen's Trust Company, St. Louis, Missouri is the bond registrar and paying agent. The Bonds are general

obligations of the District and are payable as to both principal and interest from ad valorem taxes which shall be levied, without limitation as to rate or amount, on all taxable tangible property, real and personal, within the corporate limits of the District. The District will furnish Bonds and the approving opinion of Peper, Martin, Jensen, Maichel and Hetlage, Bond Counsel, St. Louis, Missouri, to the bidder awarded the Bonds. Bids must be for all of the

Bonds at a price of not less than 98.5% of the prin amount plus accrued interest to the date of delivery. All bids must be submitted on the Official Bid Form which, together with the Preliminary Official Statement and the Notice of Bond Sale, may be obtained from the District or its financial advisor at the addresses indicated below:
Chief Richard Friedmann WM Financial Strategies
Pacific Fire Protection District 1515 N. Warson
Administration Building Suite 274
136 W. Union St. Louis, Missouri, 63132
Pacific, Missouri 63069 Attention: Ms. Joy A. Howard
(From The Bond Buyer)
